A '''fried egg''' is a cooked [[egg]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/fried_egg.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Any egg fries in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. The recipe isn't added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a fried egg takes 0.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|2}}.
